hero.title: Computer Engineering (PG) in Mauritius
hero.subtitle: A Master’s in Computer Engineering is a postgraduate programme for students interested in computer hardware, embedded systems, computer architecture, digital electronics, networking and the integration of hardware with software. It can help graduates develop advanced technical knowledge for careers in computing, telecommunications, automation and technology research. For Indian applicants exploring a **Master’s in Computer Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students**, it is important to compare available programmes and their specialisations carefully.

overview: Important course availability note: The University of Mauritius’s published postgraduate programme list for the 2026–2027 academic year does not currently list a dedicated Master’s in Computer Engineering. It lists related options such as an MSc in Artificial Intelligence and an MSc in Software Project Management, while its engineering faculty lists other specialist engineering master’s programmes. These courses are related alternatives, not equivalent qualifications in Computer Engineering. Students planning to **Study Computer Engineering in Mauritius** should verify the course title and curriculum before applying.

faq.question: Is a Master’s in Computer Engineering available in Mauritius?
faq.answer: A dedicated Master’s in Computer Engineering was not found in the University of Mauritius’s published postgraduate programme list for 2026–2027. Related options include the MSc in Artificial Intelligence, MSc in Software Project Management and MSc in Applied Computing and Digital Technologies. Students researching a Master’s in Computer Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students should verify the latest programme availability directly with universities.

faq.question: Which university offers a related master’s programme?
faq.answer: The Open University of Mauritius offers an MSc in Applied Computing and Digital Technologies. The University of Mauritius offers postgraduate programmes in Artificial Intelligence and Software Project Management. These programmes have different curricula and should not be considered direct substitutes for a Computer Engineering degree.

faq.question: What are the living expenses for international students in Mauritius?
faq.answer: The University of Mauritius estimates monthly living expenses of approximately MUR 15,000–25,000, or about ₹28,500–₹47,500 using the illustrative exchange rate in this article. Actual costs vary according to accommodation and lifestyle.

faq.question: What career opportunities are available after studying Computer Engineering?
faq.answer: Depending on the course and practical skills developed, graduates may pursue roles in embedded systems, computer systems, AI, networking, software development, hardware design or technology research. Hardware-focused roles may require specialised modules and hands-on experience.
